cards.title: Alpha Anthem
cards.description: A simple fixture card that starts with a click in the mock player.
cards.notes: Fixture used by the browser tests.

cards.title: Beta Racer
cards.description: A fixture card driven with the arrow keys and the space bar.
cards.instructions: Steer with the arrow keys and press Space to jump.
cards.notes: Fixture used by the browser tests.

cards.title: Keyboard Quest
cards.description: Only two keys are needed for this card.

cards.title: Mouse Only
cards.description: A mouse-only card whose thumbnail is missing, so the desktop must show a placeholder.
cards.instructions: Click the buttons on the stage.
cards.notes: The missing thumbnail exercises the fallback tile.

cards.title: Broken Demo
cards.description: The mock player rejects this card so the error state can be tested.
cards.notes: Mock Ruffle refuses to load this fixture.

cards.title: Slow Loader
cards.description: The mock player delays this card so the loading state stays visible.

cards.title: Missing File
cards.description: No SWF path is listed, so the Launch button must be disabled.
cards.notes: The original file could not be recovered.
